# `ptfkit.saxton1986`

```cpp
import ptfkit.saxton1986;
```

**Exported namespace:** `ptfkit::saxton1986`

Saxton et al. retention relationships parameterized by USDA CalcPTF.

## Source

Saxton, K. E., Rawls, W. J., Romberger, J. S., & Papendick, R. I. (1986). Estimating generalized soil-water characteristics from texture. Soil Science Society of America Journal, 50(4), 1031-1036.

[DOI: 10.2136/sssaj1986.03615995005000040039x](https://doi.org/10.2136/sssaj1986.03615995005000040039x)

## Scope

**Territory:** United States

**Dataset:** The retention regressions were fitted to 44 texture combinations generated from the Rawls et al. (1982) regressions for 2541 soil horizons.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/saxton1986.md)

## `Saxton1986CalcPTFParameters`

```cpp
struct Saxton1986CalcPTFParameters {
    double theta_r;
    double theta_s;
    double alpha;
    double conductivity_lambda;
};
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | Residual volumetric water content fixed to zero. (cm^3/cm^3) |
| `theta_s` | Saturated volumetric water content represented by soil porosity. (cm^3/cm^3) |
| `alpha` | Inverse Brooks-Corey air-entry pressure head. (cm^-1) |
| `conductivity_lambda` | Brooks-Corey pore-size distribution index. (dimensionless) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_saxton1986_calcptf_parameters` {#function-calc_ptf_saxton1986_calcptf_parameters}

Estimate the CalcPTF Brooks-Corey parameterization of the Saxton et al. retention relationship from sand, clay, bulk density, and particle density.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Saxton1986CalcPTFParameters calc_ptf_saxton1986_calcptf_parameters(double sand, double clay, double bulk_density, double particle_density)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sand` | Sand content under the USDA particle-size classification. (%) |
| `clay` | Clay content under the USDA particle-size classification. (%) |
| `bulk_density` | Soil bulk density used by CalcPTF to calculate porosity. (g/cm^3) |
| `particle_density` | Soil particle density used by CalcPTF to calculate porosity. (g/cm^3) |

#### Returns

A `Saxton1986CalcPTFParameters` value.

!!! note

    This API exposes the USDA CalcPTF parameterization of the 1986 regressions rather than every water-potential and conductivity function published in the article.

!!! note

    CalcPTF converts the article's air-entry tension from kPa to centimetres of water using 10 cm per kPa before taking its inverse.

!!! warning

    The article's validated texture region is piecewise: 5-30% sand with 8-58% clay, or 30-95% sand with 5-60% clay. Sand and clay must also describe a physically valid USDA texture composition.

!!! warning

    The relationships represent texture-driven statistical estimates; density, structure, organic matter, clay type, and hysteresis can affect measured retention behavior.
